Definition: a gazelle (from its lightly touching the ground)
BiblicalUsage: 1) mountain sheep, mountain goat, moufflon, gazelle, chamois (meaning uncertain); 1a) a certain animal allowed as food (specific species uncertain); 1b) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown
